Hello Southern Financial LLC,



Welcome to the Private Client Services (PCS) trader program. As part of this program you'll receive a
number of special benefits to match your trading style, including:


    •   Priority access: Direct line to a small, dedicated team of veteran traders who are ready to
        answer your questions
    •   Unmatched trader expertise: Professional-level knowledge of complex derivatives and risk
    •   Account upgrades and money movement: Priority processing to take care of your unique
        needs
    •   Risk management: Proactive outreach, assistance, and education for expiration risk,
        dividend risk, and other trading-related issues

You can learn more about the individuals on the team and their trading experience in the enclosed
bios. You'll discover they're as passionate about trading as you are. You can easily reach the team:
    •    Phone: (800) 587-2226, from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET
    •    Email: PCSTraderOtdameritrade tom
    •    Fax: (402) 970-8488
    •   Chat: Initiate a support chat request through the thinkorswim• platform, subject: PCS
        Trader



We appreciate your loyalty to TD Ameritrade and look forward to helping you take full advantage of
everything the PCS Trader program has to offer.

Sincerely,

Larry Mikell

Larry Mikell started his extensive career in trading as an OEX market maker on the Chicago Board of
Options Exchange (OBOE) in 1994. Three years later, he moved across the street to trade futures on
the Chicago Board of Trade. In 2009 he joined thinkorswim's Trade Desk as a derivatives and risk
expert. Larry is now one of our most experienced and knowledgeable Trade Desk managers and will
be overseeing this team. Outside the office, Larry enjoys spending time with his wife of 16 years and
his eight-year-old son.


Brad Judd began as a clerk at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) in 1990 with a focus on
futures options. After leaving the CME in the early 1990s to trade futures on the MidAM, he
returned to spend 20 years in the currency pits brokering options to the largest forex trading desks
of major U.S. banks with MF Global. He continued to broker forex options on the floor and Globex
until 2016 when he left to trade for his own account. Having previously run a 24-hour desk, he joined
TD Ameritrade in the fall of 2017 on the futures and forex team on the European shift. Brad
graduated from Northwestern University with a major in economics and minor in business. He holds
his Series 3, 4, 7, 24, 34, and 63.

Micah Riskin graduated from Indiana University with a major in political science and a minor in
business. A diehard fan/homer, just ask him about IU athletics. He worked at AXA helping educators
with their 403b plans and general retirement planning before joining TD Ameritrade in 2013. After
two years offering PCS-level white glove service for any back-office account issues on our concierge
team, Micah moved to our Trade Desk where he quickly became a top performer and go-to among
the former trading floor reps.
Besides complex trading strategies and the thinkorswim platform, he specializes in 1256 contracts
and 1099, as well as our mobile trading applications. Micah holds his Series 3, 7, 24, 34, and 66.

Michael Palermo began his career as an options market maker in the OEX pit at the CBOE where he
managed positions and risk as a sole proprietor for 13 years. In 2011 he joined TD Ameritrade to
support the firm's most active trader clients with a special emphasis on the thinkorswim platform.
He's known for his unmatched industry acumen as well as his expertise in portfolio margin, complex
